Build a box set What you're doing: binding several finished books into one omnibus EPUB — a trilogy in a single volume, a series starter bundle, the complete works of one productive winter. Steps Open the Export dialog and find the Box Set section. The book in the studio is always Book One . Use Add a Book… to bring in the next volumes as manuscripts ( .docx , .md , or .txt ). Each is listed with its chapter and word counts; any book can be removed again. Pick a platform preset if the set is headed for a particular store — it applies to the combined package. Choose Build Box Set .epub . Beuk assembles one volume: a divider and title page for each book, then its sections in order, book by book. How the combined book is put together One unified table of contents: each book is a part, its chapters nested beneath it. Every book keeps its own cover, images, and endnotes, rendered under that book's context. Files inside the package are volume-prefixed, so nothing from Book Two can collide with Book One. What can go wrong The combined file is enormous. Box sets add up — three image-rich novels can make a file some stores cap. If a store refuses on size, reduce image dimensions in the later volumes, or split the set. Book Two's chapters show Book One's styling. By design: a box set is one publication, typeset once, consistently. If a volume truly needs its own look, export it as its own book instead. A book imported with no chapters. Same cause as in Import a manuscript : chapters are found by heading styles. Fix them in the source file and add the book again.
